title: NXDESK shared-entity ownership contract
description: One file per shared entity. The owner app is the only app that writes the entity; the shared read layer only holds a derived copy of the listed fields. Everything later phases generate (hooks, payload projection, views, grants, commands) follows from this file. scripts/check_contracts.py enforces the rules a schema cannot express (deny-list, one owner per entity, registered apps).

entity_type.description: Stable entity name, also the shared table suffix (entity_<entity_type>) and the Read API path.

contract_version.description: Bumped on every change to fields; events carry it so a consumer can tell which shape a payload has.

owner_app.description: Registry key of the one app that owns and writes this entity (nxerp/registry.py), or a planned owner while status is planned.

source_doctype.description: The owner's DocType (or external record type for a planned owner) the entity comes from.

id_field.description: The owner's field that is the entity id. It becomes entity_id in the shared layer and is never a shared field.

tenant.description: How tenant_id is set: a constant organisation, or the entity itself when it is the organisation unit.

fields.description: The allow-list: only these fields leave the owner. Nothing else is shared.

shared.description: Column and payload name in the shared layer.

source.description: The owner's field name, or a short description of the derivation when derived is true.

class.description: Sensitivity class. S3 (finance, tax, payroll, credentials, health) is refused by the lint.

derived.description: True when the value is computed by the owner, not read from one field.

verify.description: True when the source field was not confirmed against the owner's DocType; resolved by Phase 3 contract tests on a dev site.

excluded_by_design.description: Owner fields deliberately NOT shared (documentation for reviewers; the allow-list above is what is enforced).

events.description: Owner doc_events that publish this entity to the outbox.

consumers.description: App key -> the shared fields that app may read through the Read API (a subset of fields).

commands.description: The only ways another app may ask the owner to change this entity.

status.description: planned = the owner app is not installed yet; no events are published and nothing is shown.
